Upload PDFs in English or French of your CV, official transcript, enrolment certificate and a reference dated within 12 months.

BSc/MSc applicants in computing, maths, engineering or physics need three years of full-time study by June.

rbi-summer-placement.prep_tip: Review RBI research priorities and write a specific motivation statement.
